Judgment calls: (a) V-DC 2 IS NOT DRAWN IN THE IMAGE -- its annotated bbox (164,105)-(201,142) contains only 3 dark pixels and those belong to the stub end at (165,137); the pencil symbol and its lead to resistor 0 were lost in preprocessing. I did NOT mark it unconnected: there are exactly two open wire ends in the whole drawing, the stub end (165,137) and resistor 0's left lead (249,138), and the missing V-DC's bbox sits between them, so V-DC 2 is placed across those two ends. That is also the only reading that gives the circuit a source and leaves nothing dangling. Its terminal 0 is the resistor-0 side (n1) and terminal 1 the bottom-rail side (0); the polarity marks are not visible, and 2-terminal order does not affect any metric.
